d: US President Donald Trump has cancelled planned rallies in Kansas and Iowa, while Vice President JD Vance has called off a press conference in Minnesota. Trump also lashed out at a reporter questioning the cancellations, drawing mockery from Iran. Meanwhile, the US Secret Service has deployed the Avenger Air-Defence System at Trump’s Mar-a-Lago residence amid security concerns ahead of the midterm elections.
